fields.description: Cluster this server belongs to. It provides the stores, the SSH key and the version the node runs.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Assigned on first save: n1, n2 and so on under the cluster's default domain, e.g. n1.blr.frappemail.com. It gets an A record in the zone and is what the reverse DNS of the IP must point to.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Display name shown in lists and links, e.g. Bangalore node 1. Defaults to the hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Where the server runs, e.g. DigitalOcean BLR1. Informational; placement follows the cluster's regions.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: What this node does. full: serves mail clients and sends outbound mail. frontend: serves clients only. outbound: only delivers the queue and takes no client traffic. Single-node clusters must use full.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Untick to take the node out of service: it leaves the cluster hostname's DNS and Stalwart is stopped. Tick again and Restore to bring it back.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: created, not provisioned. Provisioning: a job is running. Provisioned: installed, waiting for Stalwart to report healthy. Active: serving. Draining: removed from DNS for maintenance. Failed: the job or health check failed, see Last Error. Disabled: stopped by an operator.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Provisioned
Active
Draining
Failed
Disabled

fields.description: This node ran the first-time setup of the cluster. It cannot be deleted while the cluster is active.
fields.label: Is Bootstrap Node

fields.description: The Atlas machine this node runs on. Its public address becomes the node's.
fields.label: Machine

fields.description: Taken from the machine once Atlas reports it running.
fields.label: IPv4 Address

fields.description: Public IPv6 of the VPS, if it has one. Gets an AAAA record alongside the A record.
fields.label: IPv6 Address

fields.description: The cluster hostname currently resolves to this node, so mail clients and other servers reach it.
fields.label: In Ingress DNS

fields.description: Reverse DNS of the IPv4 address points back at the hostname. Set it at the VPS provider; receivers reject mail from servers without it. Checked daily and by Verify PTR.
fields.label: PTR Verified

fields.description: Stalwart release the last job installed on this node.
fields.label: Installed Version

fields.description: Id Stalwart's cluster registry assigned to this node. Stays 0 on single-node clusters without a coordinator.
fields.label: Node ID

fields.description: When the last provisioning or upgrade job finished successfully.
fields.label: Provisioned At

fields.description: When Stalwart on this node last answered a health check.
fields.label: Last Health At

fields.description: Health checks in a row this node failed.
fields.label: Consecutive Failures

fields.description: Who took the node out of ingress: Health, or an operator.
fields.label: Drained By

fields.description: Why the last job, health check or SSH check failed. Cleared by the next success.
fields.label: Last Error
